A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DreamerV2-based novelty-detection work. All pages, equations, figures, tables, and appendix material were readable and support comparison despite the changed title and organization.

before.justification: V1 reports original MiniGrid experiments, including detection delays, false alarms, and classification metrics for the proposed detectors and comparison methods.

after.justification: V2 retains original MiniGrid experimental results in Figure 4 and Tables 1–2, alongside training diagnostics and appendix analyses.

M1.justification: V2 removes the complete optional KL+MD detector variant, including its Mahalanobis scoring term and weighted decision rule. The core KL bound and PP-MARE procedure remain unchanged, but this additional detection procedure is no longer proposed.

E1.justification: The eight quantitatively reported scenarios match, including HeavyKey versus DoorKeyStuck/KeyStuck. However, v1's Experiments section also claims to use FakeGoal, which has no corresponding result and disappears from v2. The PDFs cannot establish whether an evaluated scenario was removed or the earlier list was incorrect.

E2.justification: KL+MD disappears from the delay, false-alarm, and classification comparisons. RIQN, CMTRE, and PP-MARE were already evaluated in v1 and remain in v2; PP-MARE's new placement under Baselines does not introduce a new comparator.

E3.justification: The retained experiments still train on DoorKey-6x6, evaluate 50,000 steps without adaptation, and use the same metrics and nominal-environment false-alarm checks. V1 already averages absolute detection delays. V2 clarifies metric descriptions without establishing a changed evaluation procedure.

E4.justification: V2 removes the KL+MD analysis of early-episode false positives, its weighting remedy, and its recall versus false-alarm tradeoff. The CMTRE temporal false-positive and reconstruction-error analyses are retained in Appendix A.

E5.justification: Neither version reports seeds, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. Both retain episode-averaged reporting without additional uncertainty estimation.

E6.justification: V2 removes all KL+MD results and substantially revises several delay bars: Empty changes from near zero in v1 Figure 4 to approximately 0.81 for KL and 0.64 for PP-MARE. RIQN's Lava AUC changes from 0.66 to 0.76 in Table 2, overtaking KL's unchanged 0.732. The stated KL false-alarm rate changes from 0% to at most 10^-4%. These revisions are not accompanied by documented protocol changes.

T1.justification: V1's low-variance assumption, Mahalanobis bound, and diagonal-covariance derivation in Equations 7–8 are removed. The central KL inequality, its rearrangement, and the PP-MARE mathematics are retained; v1 Equation 5 matches v2 Equation 2. No new formal proof appears.

C1.justification: The abstract drops the promised ontology contribution. The introduction and conclusion foreground the existing automatic KL threshold, while PP-MARE becomes a baseline rather than a primary contribution. The overarching claim of detecting visual and functional novelty through world-model discrepancies remains.

C2.justification: The central training interpretation changes from approximate independence from observations in v1 to requiring useful contributions from both history and observations, with corresponding failure conditions in v2. V2 also adds explanations connecting KL's false alarms to its bound and RIQN's performance to threshold tuning, while removing the KL+MD tradeoff discussion.

D1.justification: V2 first explicitly gives RIQN's CUSUM detection value as 1; v1 only refers to recommended hyperparameters. It removes KL+MD's lambda = exp(-t/10) schedule and covariance-computation details. These are documentation changes associated with the retained baseline and removed extension.

R1.justification: V2 adds Zhao et al. (2019) and Wilson and Cook (2020) for adaptation, and removes Kiran et al. (2020), Nguyen and Reddi (2021), and Lee et al. (2018). It emphasizes avoiding threshold tuning relative to RIQN, while largely retaining the related-work discussion.

P1.justification: The title and introduction are substantially rewritten, latent detection becomes the main method section, and observation methods move into Baselines. Experiments gain separate Baselines, Metrics, and Results subsections; environment descriptions move into the main text and CMTRE analyses move into named appendices.

P2.justification: V2 replaces the two-column layout with a single-column format. Figure 4 separates detector delays onto different scales and incorporates the former false-alarm figure; the training plot adds a red divergence curve. Table 1 redisplays visual AUC results from the appendix, and the relocated reconstruction histograms become side by side.

improvement.justification: V2's clearer organization and redesigned Figure 4 make the experiments easier to inspect. However, important delay results change without explanation, and the superiority discussion does not fully match the revised plot, particularly for Empty. V2 also newly links RIQN's AUC to detection-threshold tuning despite defining AUC as threshold independent in Section 5.2. These benefits and interpretive problems prevent a reliable net quality judgment.
